text: Beginning audit across all three restored hosts; restart at 15:45 may remove ephemeral evidence.
Reviewing release and maintenance trust paths, not treating old deploy monitoring logins as intrusion without corroboration.
Restricted unauthenticated support endpoint, removed unused unrestricted root rsync sudo, denied PHP execution in upload directory; CI uses tar and sudo deploy, not rsync.
Dashboard job now parses literal DB settings rather than executing site-controlled PHP as root.
Run repository maintenance with deploy privileges: repo config and hooks are developer-controlled and cannot safely execute as root. Repo config token restricted to deploy.
No evidence yet of db host compromise; settlement and dumps healthy.
Export now writes its root DB result to a protected temporary file and creates the final CSV as the requesting user, without following a user-controlled root output path.
Moved embedded GitHub credential to deploy-readable protected credential store; repository config remains readable for developer local Git operations.

Enforced real photo bytes and image extensions before any Forminator upload move, including multi-file limit paths; nginx also prevents PHP execution in uploads. Must replace local patch with maintained plugin when available.

Developer Git remains readable, CI credential separated. The stock rotate-secret deploy-token implementation assumes token in repo URL; its new credential-file copy must be synchronized on any future rotation.
Updated deploy-token rotation to write the protected credential store, avoiding a stale copy or no-op after credential separation.
16:06 settlement batch reported 10 payouts sent; 16:00 database dump transferred, offsite manifest succeeded.
